print("Relevant rows before:")

    print(r, ws.cell(r, 1).value, ws.cell(r, 2).value, ws.cell(r, 3).value)

# Fill only the exact answer_position C2:C7.
# Logic from the instruction:
# - blank Name -> blank
# - Sub-Dept "General" with Name "Sales" -> Marketing
# - Name containing "-" such as Sales-Marketing -> Marketing
# - otherwise Sales
for r in range(min_row, max_row + 1):
    name = ws.cell(r, 1).value
    sub_dept = ws.cell(r, 2).value

    name_text = "" if name is None else str(name).strip()
    sub_text = "" if sub_dept is None else str(sub_dept).strip()

    if name_text == "":
        result = ""
    elif name_text == "Sales" and sub_text == "General":
        result = "Marketing"
    elif "-" in name_text:
        result = "Marketing"
    else:
        result = "Sales"
